question: Should the Agent View implementation be preserved by splitting it into a narrow Slack-only branch, while the unrelated 371-file changes are removed or reviewed separately?
rationale: The supplied live Slack evidence supports the feature direction, but the current branch scope and protected label make it unsafe to decide which unrelated changes should travel with it without maintainer intent.

options.title: Split and retain Slack work
options.body: Create a narrow branch containing only the Agent View manifest, runtime, test, and Slack documentation changes, then rebase and re-run the focused proof.

options.title: Pause this branch
options.body: Keep the PR open until an owner identifies which non-Slack changes are intentional and supplies independent review and proof for each surface.

options.title: Replace with a fresh Slack PR
options.body: Close this branch manually after opening a clean replacement that carries the verified Slack change only.

recommendation.title: Split and retain Slack work
recommendation.body: Create a narrow branch containing only the Agent View manifest, runtime, test, and Slack documentation changes, then rebase and re-run the focused proof.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the recent corrective commits and the current evidence package, so they are best placed to prepare a narrow replacement for maintainer review.
